title: verify.claims.v1
description: One claim: one line of the JSONL file `verify ground` reads. Blank lines are ignored and an empty file refuses. Each claim cites text of one bound document, which may be any UTF-8 text: plain text, Markdown, HTML or XML (anything shaped like a tag is treated as markup).

claim_id.description: Names the claim in the report. Must be unique in the file.

quote.description: Text the document shows, as whole words and whole numbers. Whitespace is collapsed and HTML tags and entities are resolved before matching. Without byte_span it must occur exactly once.

byte_span.description: Half-open byte range of the raw document that holds the quote.

value.description: The claimed number, in units of `scale`. Give `value` and `scale` together.

scale.description: The scale of `value`, matched without regard to case. A percent or bps claim matches only a percent or basis-point figure.

unit.description: Optional, only with value and scale: a currency code such as USD, a currency sign such as $, or percent or bps. It passes only if the document states it on the number; a bare $ does not establish USD, and other units are never established.
